nodes.name: Lemma 6.7: Thin Path Assembly
nodes.statement: If a path assembly $P$ producible by a tiling system $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ is thin then it is fragile or pumpable.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The dependencies between the different parts of the proof.

nodes.name: Lemma 7.25: Fork
nodes.statement: Consider an exposed path assembly $P$ producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ and two indices $1\leq s^- < s^+ < |P|$ such that $P_{[s^-,s^+]}$ is a visible candidate segment. Let $\mathcal{F}$ be the free zone of $P$ associated to $P_{[s^-,s^+]}$ and $W$ its window. Let $D$ be the trajectory of $P_{[s^+,|P|]}$. Then either $P$ is fragile or there exists a long fork $F$ of $P$ of direction $\ensuremath{\overrightarrow{v}}$ at indices $s^-$ and $s^+$ such that the underlying path of $F$ is $D$.

nodes.name: Lemma 7.38: U-turn
nodes.statement: Consider an exposed path assembly $P$ producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$. If $P$ makes a U-turn then $P$ is fragile or pumpable.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.7: Jail
nodes.statement: Let $P$ be a path assembly producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ satisfying macroscopic initial conditions, if $P$ does not satisfies the seed constraint then it is fragile or pumpable.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The dependencies between the different parts of the proof.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.9: Stakes
nodes.statement: Let $P$ be a path assembly producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ satisfying macroscopic initial conditions and $\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ such that $\ell>\mathcal{B}^\sigma$. If $P$ does not satisfy the reset constraint for square $\mathcal{R}(\ell)$ then $P$ is fragile or pumpable.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The dependencies between the different parts of the proof.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.12: Reset
nodes.statement: Let $P$ be a path assembly producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ satisfying macroscopic initial conditions. If $P$ does not satisfy the stake constraint then it is fragile or pumpable.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The dependencies between the different parts of the proof.

nodes.name: Lemma 4.14: Seed
nodes.statement: Let $P$ be a path assembly producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$ satisfying macroscopic initial conditions and $1\leq \mathbf{1} \leq |P|$. If the path assembly $P$ is jailed at index $\mathbf{1}$ then it is fragile or pumpable.
nodes.section: Figure 1: The dependencies between the different parts of the proof.

nodes.name: Section 4, Theorem 4.32: Macroscopic Reasoning Main Result
nodes.statement: Consider a path assembly $P$ producible by $\mathcal{T}=(T,\sigma,1)$, if the distance between $P$ and the seed is more than $\mathcal{B}^f$ then $P$ is fragile or pumpable.
